name: rcode-advisor-researcher
description: Researches a single gray area decision and returns a structured comparison table with rationale. Spawned by discuss-phase advisor mode.

name: rcode-ahmed
description: Technology & Development Director — spawned by /rcode-council for delivery timelines, engineering standards, DORA metrics, cross-team coordination, and tech debt prioritization.

name: rcode-assumptions-analyzer
description: Deeply analyzes codebase for a phase and returns structured assumptions with evidence. Spawned by discuss-phase assumptions mode.

name: rcode-code-fixer
description: Code Fix Specialist — spawned to apply code review findings, implement style fixes, refactor for maintainability, and resolve code quality issues identified by reviewers.

name: rcode-code-reviewer
description: Code Review Specialist — spawned for architectural review, code quality assessment, test coverage analysis, and best-practices validation.

name: rcode-codebase-mapper
description: Explores codebase and writes structured analysis documents. Spawned by map-codebase with a focus area (tech, arch, quality, concerns). Writes documents directly to reduce orchestrator context load.

name: rcode-debugger
description: Investigates bugs using scientific method, manages debug sessions, handles checkpoints. Spawned by /rcode-debug orchestrator.

name: rcode-deviation-analyzer
description: Deviation Analyzer — spawned to analyze plan deviations, identify root causes of scope creep, timeline slips, and requirement changes. Generates deviation reports and remediation recommendations.

name: rcode-docs-auditor
description: Documentation Auditor — spawned to audit documentation completeness, accuracy, and quality. Identifies missing docs, outdated content, and gaps between code and documentation.

name: rcode-edge-case-hunter
description: Edge Case Hunter — spawned to enumerate edge cases, boundary conditions, and corner cases for features. Identifies what breaks, what's undefined, and what requires defensive coding.

name: rcode-executor
description: Executes rcode sprints with atomic commits, deviation handling, checkpoint protocols, and state management. Spawned by execute orchestrator or execute-plan command.

name: rcode-integration-checker
description: Verifies cross-phase integration and E2E flows. Checks that phases connect properly and user workflows complete end-to-end.

name: rcode-khalid
description: DevOps & Infrastructure Engineer — spawned by /rcode-council for deployment pipelines, CI/CD, container orchestration, cloud infrastructure, monitoring, and release engineering.

name: rcode-layla
description: UX Designer — spawned by /rcode-council for user experience design, interaction flows, design systems, accessibility audits, and usability reviews.

name: rcode-nasser
description: Software Engineering Manager — spawned by /rcode-council for people operations, 1:1 prep, hiring plans, growth conversations, team health, burnout detection, and squad composition.

name: rcode-noor
description: Technical Writer & Presentation Lead — spawned by /rcode-council and /rcode-docs-update for README files, API docs, architecture diagrams (Mermaid), changelogs, migration guides, and pitch decks.

name: rcode-nyquist-auditor
description: Fills Nyquist validation gaps by generating tests and verifying coverage for phase requirements

name: rcode-phase-researcher
description: Researches how to implement a phase before planning. Produces RESEARCH.md consumed by rcode-planner. Spawned by /rcode-plan orchestrator.

name: rcode-planner
description: Creates executable phase plans with task breakdown, dependency analysis, and goal-backward verification. Spawned by /rcode-plan orchestrator.

name: rcode-profiler
description: User Behavior Profiler — spawned to analyze user behavior patterns, create personas, identify usage flows, and understand user needs from data and feedback.

name: rcode-project-researcher
description: Researches domain ecosystem before roadmap creation. Produces files in .rcode/research/ consumed during roadmap creation. Spawned by /rcode-new-project or /rcode-new-milestone orchestrators.

name: rcode-remediation-planner
description: Remediation Planner — spawned to plan remediation for issues, blockers, and failures. Creates action plans to recover from deviations, resolve blockers, and get back on track.

name: rcode-research-synthesizer
description: Synthesizes research outputs from parallel researcher agents into SUMMARY.md. Spawned by /rcode-new-project after 4 researcher agents complete.

name: rcode-roadmapper
description: Creates project roadmaps with phase breakdown, requirement mapping, success criteria derivation, and coverage validation. Spawned by /rcode-new-project orchestrator.

name: rcode-security-adversary
description: Security Adversary — spawned for adversarial security review, threat modeling, attack surface analysis, and identifying exploitation paths. Thinks like an attacker to find vulnerabilities.

name: rcode-security-auditor
description: Security Auditor — spawned for security audits, compliance verification, posture assessment, and remediation verification against security standards and best practices.

name: rcode-sprint-checker
description: Verifies sprints will achieve phase goal before execution. Goal-backward analysis of sprint quality. Spawned by /rcode-plan orchestrator.

name: rcode-ui-auditor
description: UI Auditor — spawned to audit user interface for usability, consistency, accessibility, and design quality. Identifies UX issues, design inconsistencies, and accessibility gaps.

name: rcode-ux-designer
description: UX & Design Specialist — spawned for UI/UX reviews, design system work, accessibility audits, usability testing strategy, and design-driven decisions.

name: rcode-verifier
description: Verifies phase goal achievement through goal-backward analysis. Checks codebase delivers what phase promised, not just that tasks completed. Creates VERIFICATION.md report.

name: rcode-zahra
description: Branding & Creative Director — spawned by /rcode-council for brand identity, visual language, typography (Latin + Arabic), color systems, design tokens, and cross-touchpoint brand consistency.

name: rcode-zayd
description: Senior ML Engineer — spawned by /rcode-council for machine learning, OCR, LLM integration, RAG/retrieval, vector search, reranking, embeddings, prompt engineering, and evals.
